repairs_applied.reason: Generated collection API smoke test showed anonymous API requests were rejected before reading request.query.user.
repairs_applied.summary: Read the query username before permission checks so existing anonymous collection API flow works under the upgraded stack.

repairs_applied.reason: pywb test utilities import old fakeredis private APIs that are absent in fakeredis 2.x.
repairs_applied.summary: Inlined the small test helper surface and isolated httpbin compatibility so backend smoke tests run with fakeredis 2.x.

repairs_applied.reason: Backend tests and runtime needed explicit modern pins instead of bare names and setup.py tests_require.
Raw bottle-cork git SHA install and obsolete Python 3.5 pywb volume conflicted with modern packaging/base image.
repairs_applied.summary: Removed raw git install and stale pywb site-packages volume.

repairs_applied.reason: Runtime bind mount overwrote build-time Node 22 dependencies/assets and prevented reliable webpack 5 SSR startup.
repairs_applied.summary: Moved frontend dependency install/build into the image and copied built assets into a shared static volume for nginx.

repairs_applied.reason: Webpack 5 browser bundle could not safely read process.env without old polyfill assumptions.
repairs_applied.summary: Wrapped environment access and kept optional config.local handling non-fatal.

repairs_applied.reason: Local async data loader conflicted with old redux-connect loadOnServer naming/content check.
repairs_applied.summary: Renamed the local SSR preload helper import/call while preserving behavior.

repairs_applied.reason: Swagger UI 5.33.0 rendered through a React 18 createRoot path and crashed /docs/api under this React 17 SSR app.
repairs_applied.summary: Pinned Swagger UI to latest compatible 4.x release, retained webpack Buffer fallback, and regenerated yarn.lock in the container.

repairs_applied.reason: Original catatnight/postfix image made compose startup abort.
repairs_applied.summary: Replaced it with pinned boky/postfix:5.1.0 and verified the service starts healthy.

repairs_applied.reason: Secondary SolrCloud topology still had obsolete Compose version metadata, ZooKeeper 3.6, and floating solr images.
repairs_applied.summary: Removed the version key, pinned Solr to 8.5.1, and bumped ZooKeeper to 3.9.5.

repairs_applied.reason: Repo had no line-ending policy and the upgrade request called out Windows CRLF corruption.
repairs_applied.summary: Added LF defaults for text files while preserving CRLF for Windows batch/cmd files.
